nodes.label: Captio App - Nuevo Cliente Screen (Spanish UI)
nodes.description: Screenshot of the Captio web application dashboard in Spanish locale showing the 'Nuevo Cliente' (New Client) screen. The interface has a left sidebar with navigation items: Nuevo Cliente (active/highlighted), Clientes, Notas de caso, and Archivos. A language toggle at the bottom shows ES (selected) and EN options, with a 'Cerrar sesión' (logout) button. The main content area displays a form to generate a client intake link: a text input labeled 'Nombre o referencia del cliente' (optional, for case identification) with placeholder 'Ej. Toledo Bienes Raíces — contrato', and a blue 'Generar enlace' (Generate link) button. Below the form, a 'Enlaces pendientes' (Pending links) section shows 1 pending item labeled '#1 Toledo Realtors' with a 'Copiar enlace' (Copy link) action. The user is logged in as 'toledolaw' (shown top-right with online indicator). The branding shows 'captio' with tagline 'intake · brief · equipo'. A help button (?) appears bottom-right.
design_decisions: Link-based client intake flow — lawyer generates a shareable link, client fills the form independently
Optional reference name for internal case tracking before client responds
Pending links section shows unresponded invitations with copy action
Spanish localization active (ES selected in language toggle)
